rnEndorsementFeeUsd.sourceTitle: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Division 14, Section 1417 - Fees

history.reason: Phase 2.5: first population of this field from an official primary source. 16 CCR 1417(g): 'Application Fee for Endorsement by a Registered Nurse in Another State, District or Territory of the United States: $350.' Distinct from the $300/$350 exam-pathway fee (1417 b/c) and the $190 biennial renewal fee (1417 i) -- this is specifically the endorsement fee, matching this field's clarified definition.
